name: BlackRock
coverage: Selected India equity exposure through BlackRock-managed client funds: the BGF India Fund's disclosed top ten positions at 30 September 2026, plus the reported Ather Energy bulk purchase. This is not a complete BlackRock-wide holdings register.
limitations: BlackRock is a separate firm from Blackstone. Fund investments belong to fund investors and are not automatically BlackRock Inc. corporate holdings.
Percentages shown for the ten India Fund positions are fund allocations, not company ownership percentages. They are excluded from company-stake sorting.
Ather's trade quantity and transaction value are cross-checked through two publishers using exchange data; direct retrieval of the original exchange trade record was not completed.
The two BlackRock regional pages share one publisher. They cross-check presentation, not independent sourcing.
No increase or decrease is inferred from a single portfolio snapshot. The Ather purchase is historical; current aggregate exposure remains unverified.
Business watchpoints are analytical questions, not statements of BlackRock's private rationale. Coverage excludes other funds, ETFs, private assets and undisclosed positions.

report.title: BlackRock in India — fund holdings and disclosed activity
report.summary: BlackRock provides India exposure through multiple investment mandates. This profile covers a selected active India fund and a reported Ather purchase. The evidence shows investment exposure, but does not establish a single BlackRock-wide conviction portfolio or company ownership percentage.

sections.title: How to interpret the investor
sections.text: BlackRock manages client money across different mandates. Read the fund name and disclosure date with each position. An active fund allocation, an index-tracking holding and a corporate investment can imply different investment decisions; this profile does not combine them into one ownership figure.

sections.title: What the September portfolio reveals
sections.text: The selected fund's largest disclosed positions include banks, vehicles, components, consumer beverages and financial services. These holdings offer a starting point for researching credit demand and domestic business growth. A single month-end weight does not identify a purchase, sale or management's future trading plans.

sections.title: Ather: a purchase with clear limits
sections.text: The reported August trade establishes a dated addition by a named BlackRock fund entity. It does not identify the entire current position or validate a forecast for Ather. Historical primary fund reporting also contains Ather in another strategy, so the August trade should not be called BlackRock's first investment in the company.

sections.title: What to research next
sections.text: For company selection, test cash conversion, balance-sheet strength, returns on incremental capital and execution against guidance. Treat these as research criteria rather than an inferred endorsement by BlackRock. Comparable fund share counts across consecutive disclosures would be required to establish broader buying or selling trends.
